photos.caption: Zanzibar harbour, mid-19th century — the port Burton and Speke sailed from on 16 June 1857.
Sultan Sayyid Majid bin Said of Zanzibar (r. 1856–1870), who provided the corvette Artémise that carried the expedition to the mainland.
Richard Francis Burton, commander of the Royal Geographical Society's East African expedition. Painting by Frederic Leighton, c. 1872–1875.
Hair-dresses of the Wanyamwezi, the people inhabiting the region around Kazeh. Engraving from Burton's Lake Regions of Central Africa, 1860.
photos.credit: Richard F. Burton / Lake Regions of Central Africa (1860)

photos.caption: John Hanning Speke with a surveying sextant. Photograph by Southwell Brothers, c. 1863 — Speke conducted the canoe voyage to the northern end of Lake Tanganyika in March 1858.
